features.quote: A `finish(summary)` tool the model can call to terminate voluntarily
model emits N consecutive turns with no tool call (define N=3 — a "stall")
Tool errors must be calm and factual. Don't have the environment scold the model.
Avoid anything that primes affect ("the user is frustrated," "this is urgent," "don't disappoint")
finish framing deliberately gives explicit permission to conclude without a fix. This is fairness: you're not trapping the model
features.justification_quote: This is fairness: you're not trapping the model into thinking it *must* fix it.
